text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right off the bat,
there's something I'd love for you to see!
With those words, Special Week handed me a sheet of calligraphy paper with "I'll become the number one horse girl in Japan!" written in bold, powerful brushstrokes.

Running out of room in the latter half, the characters gradually get smaller,
so it's certainly not master penmanship, but Special Week's "flavor" really shines through.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, what do you think?
It's like my New Year's resolution, a declaration of my resolve!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
After all, this is an extremely important year
where we challenge the Classic tier!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Since it was the start of everything, I wrote it to remind myself that my goal hasn't changed!

Looking at it again, the bold brushstrokes practically bursting off the page
really convey the sheer strength of her desire to be "Number One in Japan"...!
choice_data_list: Let's become the best in Japan together!
Let's be the best in Japan together, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Having you with me is so reassuring, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...So, sorry to spring this on you, but there's something I want to talk about.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What should I do
to become the number one Umamusume in Japan...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm all about wanting to do it,
but I actually have no clue how to go about it...
choice_data_list: Let's push your strengths to the absolute max!
Let's just make sure to look after our health!
Let's master the best technique in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My strong points... you say?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... If I have even one thing where I won't lose
to anyone, I feel like I can run with confidence!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, it feels like I'll naturally start to understand
things like the timing to make a move during a race!"
Being mindful of looking for her strengths also contributed to Special Week's growth.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I see...! We have to take good care of our bodies, too!
It'd be awful if we couldn't run because of an injury or illness!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "And for that, we need to make sure to rest when it's time to rest, and sleep when it's time to sleep—"
(Grrr~...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe...
You've gotta eat a lot when it's mealtime, right?

Afterward, on our way to Hatsumode,
Special Week and I browsed food stalls and ate.
It seemed like a great way to recharge her energy for the new year.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Technique, huh...
It's true that you need it if you don't want to lose...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Still, that looks pretty tough~...! How on earth am I supposed to master it?
choice_data_list: How about starting by imitating someone who's good at it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I might be able to do that!
I'll watch my friends run and try to copy them!

Afterward, by mimicking the techniques of other Umamusume
learned from tandem training and footage,
she seemed to cultivate a knack for in-race tactics.
